chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever guarantees four (matters) for me, I will guarantee for him four houses in Paradise: Spend (in charity) and do not fear poverty, and spread the greeting of peace throughout the world, and leave disputing even if you are right, and be fair to people with yourself.
ai.seo_question: What are the four actions guaranteed to bring four houses in Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links specific social ethics to spiritual reward, emphasizing that generosity, peace, humility in debate, and self-accountability are keys to Paradise. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and *mu'amalat* (social conduct) as integral to faith, encouraging believers to prioritize justice and harmony in their interactions with the wider world.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who guarantees four (matters) to me<sup>asws</sup>, (I<sup>asws</sup> will guarantee) four houses (for him) in the Paradise – Spends (in charity) and does not fear the poverty, and discloses the greetings in the world, and leaves the disputing even if he was right, and be fair with the people from himself’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Mu’awiyah ibn Wahab from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Whoever likes to guarantee four things for me, I guarantee four homes in paradise. (He should guarantee me) to give charity without fear from his poverty, to speak out loud the greetings of peace in the world and quit excessive argumentation even though he is on the side of right. He must yield to justice for people against his own soul.”
